waivers.reason: No patched braces release exists. The advisory covers every published version (<=3.0.3), and 3.0.3 (2024-05-21) is still the latest tag. fast-glob 3.3.3, the latest release, depends on micromatch 4.0.8, which depends on braces ^3.0.3. micromatch/braces#72 was closed without a release.
waivers.exposure: Scan globs from the repository's own .repolens.yml are passed to fast-glob. A deeply nested brace pattern can crash the Node process (availability only). The pattern is chosen by whoever writes that config, not by a remote caller.
waivers.review: Delete this waiver when braces publishes a version outside <=3.0.3, or when the runtime dependency path no longer reaches braces.
